_note: Awards dataset for the txasm awards feature. Definitions for all 13 awards are authored from the vault note awards-content.md. Recipient lists are populated by parsing the 13 live txasm.org award pages (npm run import:awards -- --parse), which the parser skips footer and social links while reading. The graduate-student-award page lists several names per year with no placement, a format the line parser cannot split reliably, so its recipients are a reviewed curated list rather than the raw parse. Resolved from the live pages: Thomas Matney received the Distinguished Service Award in 1980, and the Lifetime Achievement recipients are complete (including Harold F. Foerster, Sam Houston State University). Re-run --parse to refresh from the live pages, then re-apply the curated graduate-student list before seeding.

awards.name: Thomas S. Matney Award
awards.namesakeBio: Dr. Thomas S. Matney (1928-2010) was a microbiologist and geneticist at UT MD Anderson and the first Associate Dean of the UT Graduate School of Biomedical Sciences.
awards.description: Recognizes the outstanding presentation by a postdoctoral fellow.

recipients.institution: University of Texas Health Science Center at Houston

awards.name: S.E. Sulkin Award
awards.namesakeBio: Dr. S. Edward Sulkin (1908-1972) was a virologist and Chair of Microbiology at UT Southwestern from 1945 to 1972, known for work on rabies and bats.
awards.description: Outstanding oral presentation of graduate student research in medical microbiology.
